title.ur: تنقیدی سوچ اور غور و فکر کی عملی مہارتیں (EFMP-304)

visual_style: Vertical 9:16, warm natural daylight, gentle realistic cinematic look. A Pakistani government school: whitewashed walls, a plain green blackboard with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame. Nobody speaks to the camera; the narration is a voice-over.

narrator.name: off-screen narrator
narrator.description: An unseen Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties, warm, clear and confident; voice-over only, never shown on camera.

shots.visual: A pupil in a Pakistani classroom raises her hand with a puzzled expression; the woman teacher, seen from behind, pauses mid-lesson while the class turns to look.
Close-up of a teacher's hand drawing a simple chalk diagram of three connected boxes and arrows on a plain green blackboard, no words; pupils watching.
Two student teachers debate politely across a desk, one counting points on her fingers, the other listening and nodding.
In the evening, a woman teacher at home writes in a reflective journal by lamplight, the handwriting blurred and unreadable, then pauses to think.

In a sunlit school corridor, a young woman trainee teacher holds a phone and scrolls a textbook page (screen blurred, unreadable), then looks up with a confident smile as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: ایک بچہ پوچھتا ہے: یہ سچ کیسے ہے؟ کیا آپ کے پاس جواب ہے؟
اس کورس میں آپ critical thinking سمجھیں گے، arguments پہچانیں گے اور basic logic سے ان کا تجزیہ کریں گے۔
آپ reflective teacher بننا سیکھیں گے، اپنی کلاس پر غور کریں گے اور reflective practice اپنائیں گے۔
چھ units، reflective journal بنانے اور جاری رکھنے تک، تاکہ ہر سبق سے آپ بہتر استاد بنیں۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔

end_card.headline: تنقیدی سوچ اور غور و فکر کی عملی مہارتیں (EFMP-304)
